line_items.reasoning: Q1 revenue of $634M exceeded the high end of prior guidance of $612M–$616M by ~$18M, representing a clear beat on both the quarterly and implied annual growth trajectory.

U.S. commercial revenue grew exactly 40% YoY to $150M in Q1 alone, putting the full-year $640M+ target well within reach; excluding strategic contracts, growth was 68% YoY, materially above the guided 40% floor.
Adjusted operating margin came in at 36% in Q1, well above the full-year guided range of ~31–32%, and marked the sixth consecutive quarter of margin expansion.
No specific Q1 free cash flow figure was reported in the current results to compare against the full-year $800M–$1B adjusted FCF guidance, so this cannot be judged as a beat or miss yet.

PLTR delivered record GAAP net income of $106M in Q1, extending its streak to six consecutive quarters of GAAP profitability and clearly exceeding the guidance of simply maintaining GAAP profitability each quarter.
